reviews.t: This KARMA won’t come back to bite!!
reviews.x: Love this product!  It gives a shimmer and smells amazing!  I would wear this product on days wearing shorts on an outing as it gives that beautiful, bronzed, suntan look.  It is very creamy, easy gliding lotion.  It is my favorite suntan product that I have ever used in my suntan bed. Highly recommend!  Some of the best things:  It does not leave the orange residue between your fingers, nor does it leave streaks if applied unevenly.  It is not one of the suntanning products the give the tinglin

I am big on designer skim products, so was hesitant to branch out on a different brand.  However, this lotion did not disappoint. The smell is great & it is glitter infused, so I have the most wonderful golden glittery complexion after I use it. Definitely reccomend it!

I love this product, because of the tons and tons of golden sparkles, and the instant bronze effect it gives that lasts all day! (Sometimes longer) that being said, you must apply evenly not to streaky or blotchy, this lotion will not leave your skin with that extremely lubricated feeling, it is honestly kinda dry when put on, I use this lotion along with a more hydrating tanning lotion so my skin doesn't feel super dry, and that works like a charm for me. Not a fan of the smell, however it is n
Way better price than at my tanning salon. Leaves the skin shimmery and smells great

reviews.t: Be very cautious with this bronzer
reviews.x: I like this bronzer but be very careful because it can stain. It’s also very thin so the tanner must be extremely careful to get the lotion completely smoothed out with absolutely no streaks. A lady told me it stained the seats on her friend’s car and she had to get it detailed to get the stains removed. So just be very cautious. It also has a lot of glitter but I like it. I like sparkles so it doesn’t bother me. I’m not sure I’ll order this again because of the staining factor. I’m leaning towa

reviews.t: The real product for a great price!
reviews.x: Amazing! My sister bought this from a tanning salon for $120-140. I used it once and loved it, but not the price. Bought this and it is exactly the same! Smells great with a nice glitter finish. I don't mind going tanning before or after work. It has a nice bronzer. It will stain clothes directly after work if you don't rub it in. I never have orange hands I just white with a towel when I'm done applying. The only reason I am changing bottles is that I have plateaued as I always do after finishi

reviews.t: It's a good tanner if you like bonzers
reviews.x: It's a good tanner if you like bonzers, I don't really care for them, i work at a tanning salon n we had a bottle for samples so i tried it, its has glitter in it, N gets everywhere n all over your clothes, Not to easy to wash off either, But the bonzer was nice.

I like this product I am a pretty devoted tanner at the salon I use this lotion with another lotion but the 2 together works great smells amazing
One of my all time faves. Dark color w diamond dust glitter. Exceptional product
Great color quickly and smells great.  Will definitely buy again.

If you want to look like a tan sparkling vampire from Twilight, get this stuff!! Instantly added color and sparkle. Sparkles rub off on everything. Your clothes, your car your shower will shine for days on end. Washes off skin in the shower. Much much cheaper on Amazon than at the tanning salon/gym. Personally I like the sparkles n bronzing effect. Smell is better than most tanning lotions.

reviews.t: Love this for a really bronze look
reviews.x: I love this lotion and this is actually my second time purchasing it. There ARE some pros and cons... PROS - makes your skin extra sparkly after, the bronze right after you tan is super deep!, the smell is pretty good. CONS - make sure you apply evenly or it can get streaky or wipe right off after tanning, will leave the middle of your fingers orange if not rubbed in good, very thick lotion

This stuff was too sparkly for me. It smelled amazing and gave me good color, but every time I used it I felt like I was getting ready for a rave or something. I didn’t know before ordering that it was going to be super sparkly or I probably wouldn’t have ordered it. Other than that it’s a good product for the price.  And if you like being sparkly, this is the product for you.

I love this lotion. Not only does it smell good but i turn heads when walking into a place and everyone asks me how i got so dark. Not only is this lotion awesome but i can walk in white and come out dark with in 15 minutes of tanning. Just mix it with some pure heat and boom your looking flawless with in a short time frame.

I just opened this package and twisted the top off to smell the lotion. I quickly noticed that it had been used by the dried lotion on the top and around the base of the top. This lotion has glitter in it and it’s very noticible on the black label. So I basically got someone’s used lotion, nice.

This stuff is Amazing! Even if I do not have time to go to the tanning salon, I just put some of this on and I am darker. The bronzer in this looks like a sunkissed tan on your skin. Not orange at all. I just ordered my second bottle.
bought this because i was tired of paying for the salon prices, i was warned it could be false product but it was amazing. Had the same sparkle, smell, consistency and was sealed when i received it.
I absolutely love this cream!! It smells so amazing !! It gives you such a nice colour and a nice shimmer!! I have already gone threw 4 or 5 bottles!! Highly recommend this product!!😃

reviews.t: Beautiful same day instant tan,  great shimmer, great tan lotion to create a tan too
reviews.x: I ADORE this lotion!!! It's wonderful for tanning or if you want instant color and shimmer.  I will buy bottle after bottle and tell everyone else to too! Summertime essential!
Love this product, excellent bronzer, shimmery! Smells great. Gives great color. You just have to rub evenly but if you don't it washes off and will not leave you streaked!

reviews.t: Awesome instant bronzer that provides lasting results
reviews.x: Awesome instant bronzer that provides lasting results! This lotion does contain a lot of glitter however. Very comparable to the discontinued Unicorn Sparkle.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the product's great smell.
Many reviewers love the glittery, sparkly, shimmery finish it gives.
Reviewers commonly note it provides an instant, deep bronze color.
Several reviewers warn that it can stain or rub off on clothes, cars, and other surfaces.
Some reviewers caution that it must be applied evenly to avoid streaks or blotchiness.
